notes: Correction following the prose revision. The factor by which the site's own burden would have to grow to account for half the burden of a meal occasion was published as 21.8, the result of a grid search whose first qualifying point overshot the answer. The site is half the burden exactly when it equals travel plus food, so the factor is (2.28 + 2.50) / 0.22 = 21.7. No other value changed.
